Prep vegetables batch (wash/chop/portion.description: Wash, chop, and portion vegetables for use throughout the service period. This foundational prep work enables efficient cooking and ensures consistent quality in all dishes.

Prep proteins batch (trim/marinate/porti.description: Prepare protein items by trimming, marinating, and portioning according to recipes. This task requires attention to food safety and portion control standards.

Cook high-demand dish batch (daily speci.description: Prepare the featured daily special that drives customer traffic. This high-volume cooking task requires coordination and timing to meet peak demand.

Cook staple base batch (rice/noodles/sou.description: Prepare foundational staples that accompany many dishes. These base items are essential for service and require consistent quality and proper timing.

Assemble grab-and-go items (sandwiches/s.description: Construct pre-made items for quick customer pickup. This assembly work requires efficiency and consistency to maintain quality while meeting throughput goals.

Peak-hour counter serving and packaging.description: Handle customer orders during busy periods, ensuring fast service and accurate packaging. This front-facing task directly impacts customer satisfaction and revenue.

Online pre-order packing and labeling.description: Prepare and label orders placed in advance through digital platforms. This task requires accuracy in order fulfillment and clear labeling for customer pickup.

Receive delivery and verify items.description: Inspect incoming ingredient deliveries, verify quantities and quality, and document receipt. This task ensures inventory accuracy and food safety compliance.

Store ingredients with FIFO labeling.description: Organize inventory using first-in-first-out principles and proper labeling. This systematic storage prevents waste and ensures food safety through proper rotation.

Temperature log and food safety check.description: Monitor and document food temperatures and safety compliance metrics. This quality control task is critical for health code adherence and preventing foodborne illness.

Deep clean critical stations (grill/prep.description: Perform thorough cleaning of high-traffic cooking and preparation areas. This maintenance task ensures hygiene standards and prevents cross-contamination.

Restock condiments/utensils/packaging.description: Replenish customer-facing supplies and service materials. This routine task maintains operational readiness and prevents service interruptions.

Update menu board and allergen tags.description: Modify displayed information to reflect current offerings and safety information. This communication task ensures customers have accurate information about available items.

End-of-shift closing checklist.description: Complete all closing procedures including cleaning, inventory checks, and equipment shutdown. This systematic task ensures readiness for the next service period.
